summary: VLA-Radar V3.0 Oct26 second source-verified maintenance: admit Echo p139, Progress Probes P² p140 and FastHarness p141 via 8+ section full-text arXiv v1 deep reading; isolate real robot 0–10 task-completion scores, VLABench failure AUROC and four-selected-task RoboDojo SR as three incomparable paper/case tracks (7 author and cited-baseline results). Official Echo-Sim simulation-only code, FastHarness source and baseline reproducibility scopes recorded. Verify p015 OnEvoMemory ECCV 2026 EMR Workshop Poster acceptance from organizer OpenReview and author site; do not invent official archival proceedings/DOI. Add one primary-source Google DeepMind Oct13 robotics technical news. Document Oct26 partial discovery/news audits and blocked official publisher and academic-index providers, keeping last full discovery/news checkpoints Oct04. Main protection still admin-only.

tracks.name: Echo · Five real-robot tasks, task completion score
tracks.tasks: 5 real robot tasks, 30 trials per method per task
tracks.split: Insert Flower / Capsule Toy / Insert Pen / Make Tanghulu / Open Drawer
tracks.protocol: Author's actual dual-arm wheeled humanoid five-task real experiment; 30 trials per method per task, each column is task completion score 0–10, never success rate. Baseline pi0.5 and Echo trained with matching action demonstration set; Echo also has failure/status-only data.
tracks.trainingRegime: Both models use identical action demonstrations and optimization settings in paper; Echo additionally supervises SS/FS from failure and intervention episodes. Amount and failure labels do not imply equal total data budgets.

tracks.name: P² · VLABench runtime failure monitoring AUROC
tracks.split: All-task and held-out task (Episode / State failure detection)
tracks.metric: Failure detection AUROC (not policy task SR)
tracks.protocol: Episode-level and state-level receiver-operator AUROC on original VLABench failure-detection dataset. Four columns use 0..1 AUROC, NOT robot manipulation success. 600 evaluated rollouts, separate successful-demo training for P2 probe; supervised baselines may use failure labels.
tracks.trainingRegime: P2 uses 300 successful demonstrations (50/task) to train linear progress probes on fixed pi0.5 representations; SAFE-MLP/LSTM supervised comparison may use failure labels. Different label access, not equal training recipes.

tracks.name: FastHarness · 4 selected RoboDojo simulation task success rates
tracks.split: Build tower / Fold clothes / Bottle disposal / Classify objects
tracks.metric: Native task success rate (four selected tasks)
tracks.protocol: Original author's four separate RoboDojo Isaac Sim tasks with 16,20,20,9 repeats respectively, frozen pi0.5 and GPT reviewer; not the official RoboDojo 42-task protocol, cannot blend with public leaderboard. Unweighted four-task average 97.19% differs from pooled 63/65 success.
tracks.trainingRegime: No policy retraining; external GPT reviewer and accumulated per-task review experience across episodes. Token and latency measurement depends on service, GPU H20, 0.04s simulation control, and context reuse.

results.locator: §4.2 Table 2 baseline real robot Task Completion Score mean (0–10), 30 trials/task
results.trainingData: Matched successful action demonstration and recovery training for action imitation; baseline lacks Echo's additional failure-state auxiliary supervision.
results.evaluationNotes: Original task completion score on 0–10 scale, NOT SR. Author reported mean +/- SE (SE preserved in original); status detection F1 is separate metric.

results.locator: §4.2 Table 2 Echo real robot Task Completion Score mean (0–10), 30 trials/task
results.trainingData: Action demonstrations matched to π₀.₅ baseline; Echo also uses failure and intervention trajectories for SS/FS labels.
results.evaluationNotes: Original 0–10 task completion score, NOT success rate. No independent reproduction and no interpretation of F1 as robot control ability.

results.trainingData: 300 successful demonstrations, 80/20 probe train/calibration, six VLABench tasks; no failed demonstrations used for probe supervision.
results.evaluationNotes: The 600 evaluation rollouts are 300 success/300 failure with failure timing annotated for evaluation only. AUROC is NOT task SR.

results.trainingData: Failure-labeled baseline as described in the paper; not same label access as P² successful-only probe training.
results.evaluationNotes: Reported baseline AUROC, state-level and episode-level detection. Different supervision; no absolute SR.

results.trainingData: Supervised baseline may use failure trajectory labels and sequence information, distinct from P² successful-only linear probe.
results.evaluationNotes: Reported baseline AUROC only; detection time differs from compute latency.

results.trainingData: Comparison method with originally reported observation and/or policy features; not matched to linear probe architecture.
results.evaluationNotes: Author's source table reported AUROC, not robot task success.

results.trainingData: Frozen π₀.₅ model and GPT-6 Astra review scheduling, task-specific experience memory retained across episodic execution.
results.evaluationNotes: Four selected tasks only. The 97.19% is unweighted four-task mean, not the 42-task official RoboDojo ranking or 63/65 pooled episode success.
